music: warm nostalgic 1980s soft rock instrumental, clean electric guitar arpeggios, Rhodes electric piano, soft analog synth pad, light brushed drums, mellow bass, sentimental golden-hour feeling

shots.brief: Early morning in a wood-panelled 1985 kitchen. Sunlight through lace curtains. A chrome stovetop coffee percolator bubbles on a white enamel stove, steam rising. A woman's hand in a knit sleeve turns the dial of a small brown transistor radio on the counter. Close, warm, quiet.

A tree-lined residential street at 7 a.m. in autumn, maple leaves orange and red. A boy of about 12 in a puffy vest rides a red banana-seat bicycle along the sidewalk with a canvas bag of newspapers and tosses a rolled newspaper onto the porch of a white clapboard house. Camera at the edge of the lawn, still.

A father in a plaid flannel shirt reads a broadsheet newspaper at a yellow Formica kitchen table, seen from the side, a ceramic mug of coffee steaming beside him, a cereal box and a glass bottle of milk on the table. He turns the page slowly.

A woman in a camel coat with 1980s feathered hair walks down a driveway and gets into a brown 1984 Toyota Corolla sedan parked in front of a white house with a wooden garage, autumn leaves on the driveway. She closes the car door. Seen from across the street, wide, morning light.

Main street of a small Pennsylvania town in 1985, morning: brick storefronts with awnings, a five-and-dime, a diner with a neon sign, a red 1979 Chevrolet Impala and a station wagon with wood panels roll slowly past, a few people in coats walk the sidewalk. Slow sideways slide along the sidewalk.
shots.en: main street was the whole world

shots.brief: An office in 1985: close on a woman's hands typing on a pale blue IBM Selectric typewriter, the golf-ball type element moving, the paper advancing, a green-shaded desk lamp and a Rolodex beside it, morning window light. Slow push-in.

A 1950s-style diner counter at lunch in 1985: chrome stools with red vinyl, a waitress in a pale blue uniform pours coffee from a glass pot into a thick white mug in front of a man in a work jacket, a pie case with slices under glass, a jukebox glowing at the back. Side view from the counter end.

A 1985 supermarket checkout: a cashier in a smock rings up groceries on a mechanical cash register with pop-up price numbers, a bagger packs brown paper bags with a cereal box, a carton of eggs and a can of soup, a magazine rack beside the lane, fluorescent light. Side view.

A small full-service gas station in 1985 at golden afternoon light: an attendant in a striped work shirt and cap fills a 1980s Ford pickup truck from an old pump with mechanical rolling number wheels, the price sign reads 89 cents a gallon in plastic numbers. The numbers on the pump roll. Still camera.
shots.en: someone filled the tank for you

shots.brief: A cul-de-sac in a 1985 suburb at golden hour: four kids in striped t-shirts and corduroy pants ride BMX bikes and one skateboards in slow loops on the street, long shadows, a station wagon in a driveway, maple trees. Wide still shot from the end of a driveway.
shots.en: home when the streetlights came on

shots.brief: A family dinner in 1985 at dusk in a dining room with flowery wallpaper and a brass chandelier: a mother sets a casserole dish down on a lace tablecloth while the father and two children sit around the table passing a bowl of mashed potatoes. Warm lamplight, seen from the doorway, nobody looks at the camera.

A 1985 living room at night: two children in pyjamas sit on an orange shag carpet in front of a big wooden console television showing a fuzzy colourful cartoon, the screen's glow on their faces, a wood-panelled wall, a lamp, the father in a recliner behind them. Seen from behind the children.

A wooden front porch of a white house at blue hour in autumn 1985: the yellow porch light glows, a screen door, two rocking chairs, a couple sits rocking slowly with mugs, the street lamps come on along the quiet street, a few leaves drift down. Wide still shot from the front lawn.
